- **Note:** S05 j78: 西花园在畅春园西, 南垣为进水闸, 水北流注于马厂诸渠; main hall 讨源书屋 five bays, 观德处; Qianlong held audience there when visiting his mother. Kangxi's heir 胤礽 (理密亲王) moved there (j76).
